articles.title: BBC Women's Football Weekly - City lead, Arsenal struggle and Putellas delivers: The WSL half term review! - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: What are the key takeaways from the first five weeks of the Women's Super League season?
articles.body:
Radio 5 Live , · 06 Oct 2026 , · 25 mins

As we reach the first international break of the season, Ellen White is joined by BBC Women's Sport Reporter Jo Currie and the Telegraph’s Women’s Football reporter Kathryn Batte to provide a half term review of the Women’s Super League. Five games in, Manchester City remain the team to beat and Arsenal’s struggles continue. The team discuss if the reigning champions can keep their momentum going and are the problems deeper than on the pitch at Arsenal who sit 10th, 10 points adrift of the league leaders. Jo also asks if London City Lionesses have lived up to the hype given their big summer transfer window and puts Ellen and Kathryn to the test in a quick fire round assessing each club’s performance so far. TIMECODES: 00:04 - Ellen White and Jo Currie are down at St. George’s Park. 01:10 - Ellen and Jo are joined by Kathryn Batte for a WSL half term review, starting with Arsenal. 11:25 - Manchester City remain the team to beat. 16:12- London City Lionesses deliver on their pre-season hype. 20:40 - Quick fire reviews of the rest of the league.

articles.title: Las mejores selecciones UEFA del momento: España... y Gibraltar
articles.standfirst: Enlazan seis partidos consecutivos sin conocer la derrota
articles.summary: Enlazan seis partidos consecutivos sin conocer la derrota
articles.body: El primer parón de selecciones de la temporada está llegando a su fin y ha dejado varias sorpresas destacas. Entra ellas, la protagonizada por Gibraltar, la selección UEFA más en forma del momento después de España. A la espera del partido de esta noche contra Croacia, la Selección enlaza más de 40 partidos sin conocer la derrota. Gibraltar todavía está muy lejos de alcanzar semejantes registros. Ahora bien, pueden presumir orgullosos de que ninguna otra selección europea supera sus seis encuentros consecutivos sin perder. Después de enlazar una racha de 12 derrotas consecutivas y 15 partidos sin lograr ni una sola victoria, Gibraltar puso fin a esta dinámica el pasado mes de junio goleando a las Islas Vírgenes Británicas (4-0) en un amistoso. Le cogieron el gusto y volvieron a pasar por encima, en esta ocasión, de las Islas Caimán (4-1). Llegado el parón de septiembre, organizaron un amistoso contra Santo Tomé y Príncipe que acabó en empate (0-0)... así como sus dos compromisos en la Liga D de la Nations League contra Andorra (0-0) y Malta (1-1). Han acabado, eso sí, de la mejor manera posible logrando una victoria frente a Liechtenstein (0-2) en su último amistoso. El artífice de esta seguidilla de buenos resultados es Scott Wiseman. Nacido en Kingston upon Hull, decidió representar a Gibraltar tras disputar tres partidos con la Sub20 de Inglaterra y se acabó retirando con 38 internacionalidades a sus espaldas. Durante unos meses, compatibilizó el cargo de seleccionador masculino y femenino hasta que, en junio, le dieron las riendas del equipo masculino. "Es un gran honor haber sido nombrado seleccionador de la selección masculina de Gibraltar. Representar a Gibraltar, primero como jugador y luego como seleccionador, ha sido el mayor honor de mi carrera", confesó en su presentación. "Estoy ilusionado con la oportunidad que se me presenta y me comprometo plenamente a ayudar a nuestros jugadores a seguir creciendo, compitiendo y haciendo que Gibraltar se sienta orgulloso en el ámbito internacional". La mayoría de futbolistas de la selección juegan en la liga local. Una de esas pocas excepciones es James Scanlon (Leicester, 2006). Formado en la cantera del Manchester United, el Arsenal lo incorporó este pasado verano para su filial. Siempre ha representado a Gibraltar desde las categorías inferiores y, en marzo de 2024, Julio Ribas le convirtió en el debutante más joven del país con poco más de 17 años. Arrancando como extremo, ya suma seis goles. El último, en el empate ante Malta. "Estamos ganando confianza y practicando nuestro juego", dice un Scott Wiseman que se marca el ambicioso objetivo de acabar el año sin perder. Por delante, a Gibraltar le restan dos partidos de Nations League contra Andorra y Malta que tendrán lugar en el parón de selecciones del mes de noviembre. "¡Que Gibraltar esté en una racha de seis partidos sin perder no es algo que jamás pensé que estaría escribiendo! La pregunta es, ¿serán ellos los outsiders para la próxima Eurocopa...?", escribía en 'X' la cuenta 'The European Football Express'. "Creo que te refieres a la respuesta", respondió el perfil de la federación. Lo que está claro es que sólo España atraviesa un mejor momento de forma.

articles.title: 'I wish he was African', Benin coach on facing Messi in last Argentina game
articles.summary: A tiny west African nation, Benin will be the final opponent of Lionel Messi's international career when they face Argentina in Buenos Aires' Estadio Monumental.
articles.body:
Twenty-one years after Lionel Messi helped Argentina beat Nigeria in the Under-20 World Cup final, another African side will be on the pitch for the final match of his international career.

Benin face Argentina at the Monumental Stadium in Buenos Aires on Tuesday in a farewell match for the 39-year-old.

For Benin assistant coach Tunde Adelakun, there is a neat symmetry to the occasion.

"Africa has been at the heart of Messi's remarkable career," he told BBC Sport Africa.

"I was physically there when they beat Nigeria in the final, where he was the most valuable player in that tournament.

"It's an absolute pleasure that, when he is drawing the curtain on his international career, Benin will be part of that."

Messi announced his international retirement on 31 August after Argentina's defeat by Spain in the 2026 World Cup final.

Argentina's most-capped player and record goalscorer has scored 125 times in 207 senior internationals.

The Argentine Football Association has organised Tuesday's match as a farewell for its captain, with members of the 2022 World Cup-winning squad also invited to the celebrations.

For Benin, ranked 93rd in the world and yet to qualify for a World Cup, the invitation came as a surprise.

"Everybody was absolutely ecstatic," Adelakun says.

"It came at a time when we were right in the middle of preparation for two very important qualifying games for the Africa Cup of Nations."

Benin drew 1-1 away to Burkina Faso before beating Mauritania 2-1 in their opening two qualifiers.

Head coach Gernot Rohr says his side will enjoy "a bit of a party with Messi", but has stressed that they are not travelling to Buenos Aires simply to make up the numbers.

There is history behind the African connection to Messi's international career.

On 2 July 2005 in Utrecht, an 18-year-old Messi scored two penalties as Argentina beat Nigeria 2-1 to win the Under-20 World Cup.

He finished the tournament as its leading scorer and was awarded the Golden Ball as its best player.

Three years later, Messi faced Nigeria in another final.

Argentina won Olympic gold at Beijing 2008 with a side featuring Angel Di Maria, Sergio Aguero and Javier Mascherano. Di Maria scored the only goal as Nigeria took silver.

At senior World Cups, Messi has played African opposition six times.

Nigeria faced him in 2010, 2014 and 2018, before Argentina met Algeria, Cape Verde and Egypt during their run to the 2026 final.

Rohr was Nigeria coach for the last of those three meetings with the Super Eagles, a 2-1 Argentina victory in Russia in which Messi scored the opening goal.

The German has been in charge of Benin since 2023 and has described Tuesday's match as a "historic moment".

Adelakun also traces his own connection to Messi back to that 2005 final.

For Benin, however, facing Argentina will be a first.

'Football is my passion - I cannot miss this game'

Benin captain Steve Mounié has been part of the national side since 2015, but injury means he will not be able to play in Buenos Aires.

That has not stopped him making the journey.

When he realised he would miss the match, Mounié says his immediate reaction was: "Oh no, I'm going to miss the game."

He ultimately paid for his own ticket to ensure he could be there and hopes to sit on the bench with the Benin staff.

"Football is my passion," he says. "I cannot miss a game."

For Adelakun, the fixture is also an opportunity for Benin's players to perform on an unusually large global stage.

"I have continually told these players that this is a good showcase for them," he says.

He hopes the match can "show the world that Benin can play football", describing a team built on collective effort.

"We fight. We are a team like a family," he says.

Adelakun says supporters at home are more excited by the occasion than preoccupied with the score.

"I don't think many people are even talking about what the result will be," he says.

"What we are thinking about is the fact that Benin is being brought on to the international football map in this very big way."

For Adelakun, Messi's longevity and mentality are as significant as the trophies and goals.

"He is the very best of them all," he says.

But Mounié is not expecting Benin's players to spend the final whistle fighting over one famous souvenir.

Asked whether they will chase Messi's shirt, the captain says the moment should belong to the Argentine.

"If I was him, I wouldn't give my jersey to anyone, to be honest," he says.

"He needs to enjoy this moment as a football player, and he deserves to have a moment where he just enjoys."

articles.title: Glen Kamara: QPR midfielder might miss West Ham game if Fifa intervene in Finland dispute
articles.summary: QPR might be without Glen Kamara for Friday's Championship game against West Ham, if Fifa intervene in a club versus country dispute.
articles.body:
Queens Park Rangers might be without midfielder Glen Kamara for Friday's Championship game against West Ham United, if Fifa is asked to intervene in a club versus country dispute.

The Football Association of Finland says Kamara, 30, was withdrawn from international duty by QPR , external before Tuesday's Uefa Nations League game against Hungary.

"Glen was in a difficult situation as his club insisted he leave the camp and return to London," head coach Jacob Friis is quoted on the federation's website as saying. "He had to make a decision that was obviously not what we wanted."

Fifa rules state a player released for international duty must be available to their nation for the entire window, unless an earlier return is separately agreed.

A withdrawn player may also not play for their club five days after the end of the window, without the consent of the national team association.

In his pre-match media duties before the West Ham game, QPR boss Julien Stephan said: "There is a dialogue between the club and the Finland federation. We will take a decision after that discussion."

Friday's game with West Ham is scheduled to take place three days after the end of the international window.

"The regulations are very clear, and in our view, they were not fully followed in this case," Marco Casagrande, general secretary of the Finnish FA, told the Helsingin Sanomat newspaper (link in Finnish) , external .

"Fifa will definitely be informed. The player has not been available for the entire international window, as the regulations say he should be. After that, it's up to Fifa how they proceed with the matter."

Of QPR's eight Championship games so far this season, Kamara has started three and been used as a substitute in four. Rangers are sixth in the table.

Kamara did not feature in Finland's opening Nations League game against San Marino, and came off at half-time in their second match against Belarus. He was then brought on after 45 minutes against Albania on Saturday.

The Football Association of Finland told BBC Sport its focus was now on Tuesday's game with Hungary.

articles.title: La sorpresa de Costas por el fichaje de Morales: "Conoce mucho a Calero y se adaptará rápido"
articles.standfirst: Echa flores a su nuevo compañero y asegura que la plantilla del Oviedo está feliz con el 'Comandante'
articles.summary: Echa flores a su nuevo compañero y asegura que la plantilla del Oviedo está feliz con el 'Comandante'
articles.body: El central David Costas, uno de los capitanes del Real Oviedo, dijo este martes sobre José Luis Morales, fichaje exprés del club azul, que "conoce mucho a (el entrenador Julián) Calero y es fácil que se adapte rápido". "Sí me sorprendió el fichaje, porque no se venía hablando. Luego ves quién es y ya te cuadra. Te das cuenta de que el míster ha pedido que venga a ayudarnos y estamos contentos con él. Ojalá nos pueda ayudar, no vamos a descubrir ahora qué tipo de futbolista es Morales", explicó el zaguero en la sala de prensa de El Requexón. Costas no tuvo reparos en analizar las últimas derrotas del Real Oviedo a domicilio, un 3-1 en Sabadell y un 4-1 ante el Eldense, dos recién ascendidos, asegurando que "durante los 90 minutos de cada partido" los jugadores carbayones no fueron capaces de "ganar un duelo a su par". "Hoy tuvimos vídeo y el míster nos ha enseñado el problema que tuvimos en Elda y el equipo es consciente de que tanto con como sin balón no estamos encontrando buenas sensaciones", afirmó el central gallego sobre los problemas que está teniendo el Oviedo. Aunque comenzó el curso como titular, Costas ha perdido el sitio en el once tras una pequeña lesión muscular y ahora Calvo y Carlos Domínguez están afianzados en el eje de la zaga, algo que no le preocupa al central ya que, a pesar de esperar su oportunidad, dijo que es del Oviedo y que "lo más importante es ganar partidos". El de esta mañana fue el primer entrenamiento de la semana para el Real Oviedo, que tuvo tres días de descanso tras caer ante el Eldense; Calero tuvo siete bajas por lesión (Escandell, Juan Cruz, Ilyas Chaira, Estanis Pedrola, Chris Ramos, Carlos Fernández y Alexandru Isfan) y pudo contar durante toda la sesión con José Luis Morales.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Mbappe Top Sportico List of 2026's Highest-Paid Soccer Players
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo is expected to remain the world's highest-paid soccer player heading into the 2026-27 season.
articles.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo is expected to remain the world's highest-paid soccer player heading into the 2026-27 season.

Ronaldo is projected to earn a projected $300 million this season in combined on-field and off-field earnings, according to a report published Tuesday by Sportico's Justin Birnbaum .

That is double the total earnings projected for Lionel Messi, who ranks second on the list with a projected $150 million in earnings this season, per Birnbaum.

FIFA Knew Before World Cup Congo Goalie was Ineligible

Ronaldo's spot on top of the list is nothing new. He was also listed as the world's highest-paid athlete by Sportico in 2025.

Ronaldo is set to receive more in on-field earnings this season ($250 million) than any other player is making in combined earnings, according to Birnbaum.

That's in large part because of the $250 million Ronaldo is set to receive from his Saudi club Al Nassr, which Birnbaum reported "is believed to be subsidized by commercial agreements orchestrated by the club."

Messi is set to receive $75 million from Inter Miami this season, per Birnbaun, in a deal that makes him the highest paid player in the MLS.

Kylian Mbappé joins Ronaldo and Messi as the only other player set to projected to earn more than $100 million next season. He is expected to collect $70 million in on-field earnings as he heads into his third season with Real Madrid, per Birnbaum.

Two other Real Madrid players made Sportico's list in Vinicius Jr. and Jude Bellingham, while Barcelona star Lamine Yamal also ranked among the highest-paid players in the sport.

Ronaldo's Al-Nassr teammate Sadio Mané also made the list thanks to $50 million in projected on-field earnings by Spotrac.

Other players represented on Sportico's list included Manchester City's Erling Haaland as well as Harry Kane and Mohamed Salah, who are playing in German and Turkish professional leagues, respectively.

The earning estimates shared by Sportico do not include investment income, taxes or agents' fees, Birnbaum noted.

The total season-long amount earned by these highest-paid players increased just one percent from last season to $935 million, according to Birnbaum. He noted most of these stars are returning to the same clubs they played with last season, outside of Salah signing a two-year deal this offseason with Trabzonspor.

articles.title: Reports: FIFA Knew Before World Cup that Congo Goalie was Ineligible in Key Qualifying Games
articles.summary: GENEVA (AP) — FIFA knew before the World Cup that Congo's goalkeeper was ineligible when he played in multiple qualifying games and let him continue at the tournament, according to media reports on Tuesday.
articles.body:
GENEVA (AP) — FIFA knew before the World Cup that Congo's goalkeeper was ineligible when he played in multiple qualifying games and let him continue at the tournament, according to media reports on Tuesday.

The New York Times and French daily Le Monde cited internal FIFA documents about the case of Lionel Mpasi that increased scrutiny on the soccer body's disciplinary processes under President Gianni Infantino after the World Cup furor around United States forward Folarin Balogun.

FIFA said on Tuesday its disciplinary officials dealt in March with a protest about Mpasi and "strongly rejects any suggestion that the FIFA President would interfere with these processes."

The 32-year-old Mpasi was a France Under-17 international and never completed the FIFA process of switching his national eligibility to Congo where he has family ties, the reports said.

Mpasi played in all four of Congo's games at the World Cup including the 1-1 draw against Cristiano Ronaldo and Portugal , and a standout display in a 2-1 loss to England in the round of 32.

An Associated Press report in Atlanta about Mpasi facing England noted he "will have to console himself with one of the great defensive performances in a tournament filled with stellar play from the keepers."

Yet Mpasi never was eligible to play in five games that took Congo to the World Cup and could have been forfeited under FIFA rules, the reports said Tuesday.

He played in five qualifiers in the past year including an African playoff win over Nigeria last November, and an intercontinental playoffs win over Jamaica in March that sent Congo to its first World Cup for 52 years.

The Nigerian soccer federation formally complained to FIFA about possible rule-breaking by Congo giving passports to players to make them eligible to represent the country.

The New York Times and Le Monde cited internal documents from the investigation that FIFA disciplinary lawyers noted Mpasi did not have formal approval from the governing body when he was first called up to the national team in 2021.

The FIFA disciplinary officials drafted options including letting Nigeria replace Congo to play Jamaica or dismissing the Nigerian complaint on the technicality of a late filing, the reports said. In a FIFA ruling from qualifying games for the 2018 World Cup, Bolivia defaulted two games for fielding an ineligible player.

The section of FIFA's disciplinary code relating to fielding ineligible players states the body "may act ex officio," meaning it has powers to take on a case outside of a complaint.

FIFA said on Tuesday a protest by Nigeria's federation to the disciplinary committee "was declared inadmissible by this FIFA body."

"This disciplinary decision was communicated to (Nigeria) in early March 2026, and as no proper appeal was lodged the decision became final and binding," FIFA said in a statement.

The FIFA documents also noted, Le Monde reported, that defaulting Congo's results in qualifying games that Mpasi played would have sent Burkina Faso instead into the African playoffs.

African soccer leaders meeting FIFA this week

The reports on Tuesday were published one day before officials from Congo, Nigeria and Burkina Faso were set to attend a three-day summit of the 54-member Confederation of African Football (CAF) in Cape Verde. Infantino is expected to attend.

The president of Congo's soccer federation is a close friend of Infantino, Véron Mosengo-Omba, who was elected unopposed in May after being CAF general secretary for several years. Infantino and Mosengo-Omba studied together at university in Switzerland and later were colleagues at UEFA and FIFA.

The African soccer summit comes as Infantino is relying on the continent's support in the FIFA presidential election scheduled in March.

articles.title: Northern Ireland: 'Real buzz' around Northern Ireland - Shea Charles
articles.summary: Northern Ireland midfielder Shea Charles says "he could not be happier" following the side's unbeaten Nations League window.
articles.body:
Northern Ireland midfielder Shea Charles said "he could not be happier" following the side's unbeaten Nations League window.

Michael O'Neill's outfit are the only team within this year's competition who did not concede a goal during the extended four-game international break.

There has been much excitement and anticipation around the young squad who sit top of League B Group 2, and Charles thinks that the same feeling is felt within the team itself.

"I think everyone in the country is buzzing at the moment," Charles said.

"We have that same feeling in the changing room. I am really excited. We will take it game by game, but it's a real buzz.

"I thought it was a really good window. I think the boys have dealt with it so well. It's a lot of time to spend with each other. It's a really good group and we're top of the group, so I couldn't be happier."

'We have been really professional and really mature'

Northern Ireland opened their League B2 account with a win away to Georgia before a goalless draw at Windsor Park against Hungary.

They then beat Ukraine in emphatic fashion in Trnava and finished with another 0-0 home draw, this time against Georgia.

"There have been some really close moments where the game can go either way," he continued.

"I think we have been really professional and really mature in the way we have handled that away from home and I think that has been really good.

"We've created a lot of chances at home, probably more tonight than we did against Hungary. On another night they go in, we've got some top players up there that are more than capable of scoring goals so I'm sure the goals will come at home."

The longer window has also given O'Neill the chance to hand up and coming players in an already young squad some all-important game time.

Liverpool youngster Kieran Morrison made his competitive debut during the window with centre-backs Ruairi McConville, 21, and Tom Atcheson, 20, also impressing this campaign.

Meanwhile, Ceadach O'Neill also showed glimpses of potential when he was brought on for his fourth cap which means he can no longer switch international allegiance.

"More games give more players more opportunities to shine," he added.

"I think every player that's played has shown that they're more than capable of playing and starting in this team.

"There's a lot of competition at the moment and it's really healthy. It's only going to make us better. We've just got to come back and do a good job in November."

articles.title: Manchester City: Rival clubs want more than relegation from the Premier League
articles.summary: A number of Premier League clubs want Manchester City to be hit with both retrospective punishments and sanctions in the future.
articles.body:
A number of Premier League clubs want Manchester City to be hit with both "retrospective punishments" and sanctions for the future for their mass financial rule-breaking, sources have told BBC Sport.

An independent commission found City guilty of all charges relating to breaches of the Premier League's financial regulations between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 seasons.

City have appealed against the verdict, while the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) is poised to look at the findings to see if there may be any suggestions of potential misconduct.

However, there is said to be a consensus among a group of top-flight club executives that if City's appeal is unsuccessful, the sanctions should make reparations for the period when they broke the rules, while also limiting their powers in future.

There is also a feeling from at least four Premier League boardrooms that a "one-hit" points deduction resulting in relegation to the Championship would be an insufficient punishment given the severity of City's wrongdoing.

There is understood to be nuance in exactly what clubs consider a fitting penalty for the eight-time Premier League champions, who were found guilty of all serious financial rule breaches in a damning verdict by an independent commission.

One senior club source said City should be stripped of their titles, and added there was "no great rush" among clubs to push for the redistribution of trophies, but rather to take honours away and leave them vacant.

The source warned the credibility of the Premier League would be lost if City were allowed to keep the eight major trophies they won during the period they have been found guilty.

However, in a sign of a range of opinions across the league, BBC Sport was previously told there was little appetite among other clubs for City to be stripped of titles.

Regarding the timescale for sanctions in the future, there is a concern among club executives that a sanction applied just to one season would merely provide City with a "bump in the road" given the likelihood of them returning to the Premier League at the first time of asking.

A number of Premier League figures therefore believe any points deduction should be split over multiple seasons, while there is also a sense that transfer bans that stretch over a number of windows would also significantly hinder City's ability to regain their top-flight status as quickly as possible.

Which clubs did Man City's 'inflated' money flow to in transfer market?

Man City whistleblower to lose witness protection

One club source also said it would be "bizarre, almost obtuse" if City were able to trade in the upcoming January transfer window, if this process is ongoing and sanctions have not been applied.

Some clubs cited feeling "in the dark" regards the Premier League, including around the chronology and timescales of the appeal and the sanctions hearing.

However, sources said there was "empathy" and "understanding" about the difficult position the Premier League is in, given the gravity of this situation and the ongoing legal process.

Regarding financial reparations, one idea that has been mooted - and which a club source found "merit" in - was to apply a "tariff-based system", whereby City's past league finishing positions would be altered via a points deduction.

Rival clubs could then be paid compensation by City based on where they would have finished versus where they did finish.

BBC Sport understands Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca will speak to players collectively after they arrive back from international duty on Thursday, before their Premier League match against Liverpool on Sunday (16:30 BST).

The trip to Anfield is their first game since news of the verdict broke.

Merseyside Police says it has received queries in relation to the match, and when asked by BBC Sport if any special measures would be put in place the force said it will have "an appropriate policing operation in place on the day".

Sources at Liverpool have told BBC Sport it is a case of "business as usual" and there are no extra measures being put in place. Conversations and meetings between the club, supporters and relevant authorities take place before every home game.

One source said while everyone "has the right to express their feelings" they hoped supporters would not overstep the mark.

articles.title: Urban Meyer Rips 'Train Wreck' Michigan After Losses to Iowa, Minnesota amid Underwood's Struggle
articles.summary: Fox Sports college football analyst and three-time national champion head coach Urban Meyer called Michigan football's offense a "train wreck" after back-to-back losses to Iowa (20-19) and Minnesota (20-17).
articles.body:
Fox Sports college football analyst and three-time national champion head coach Urban Meyer called Michigan football's offense a "train wreck" after back-to-back losses to Iowa (20-19) and Minnesota (20-17).

Meyer made his remarks on the latest edition of AMP Sports' Original series The Triple Option (21:28 mark).

"It's an enigma right now…You can blame Bryce Underwood all you want. I don't see any explosiveness on offense. I see a quarterback getting hammered…And I don't see a fast solution at all. It's a train wreck right now. I stood right there and watched it."

Michigan's offense has not fared well in new head coach (and former Utah HC) Kyle Whittingham's first season. Outside of a 52-17 win over 1-4 UTEP, the Wolverines have averaged just 15.75 points in four games. That figure is 105th in Division I-FBS.

Quarterback Bryce Underwood has thrown for just five touchdowns and 176.2 passing yards per game in five starts. The running game is averaging only 3.9 yards per carry.

The Wolverines also blew fourth-quarter leads each of the past two weeks.

Iowa trailed 19-14 before a game-ending 20-yard touchdown pass with no time left.

Against Minnesota, Michigan led 14-7 at half and 14-13 early in the fourth quarter before an Underwood interception set up the Golden Gophers' game-winning three-play, 35-yard touchdown drive.

Of course, the year began with a controversial win over heavy underdog Western Michigan, in which the heavily favored Wolverines won 12-7. Underwood initially threw an incomplete Hail Mary attempt that led to time running out. However, one second was put back after review, and Underwood hit JJ Buchanan for a touchdown on the second Hail Mary for the win.

The Wolverines have tough matchups up ahead. Four of their remaining seven opponents are in the Top 25: No. 7 Indiana, No. 13 Oregon, No. 21 UCLA and No. 5 Ohio State.

The Wolverines will be tested further, but they have an upcoming bye week to recalibrate. Their next game is Saturday, Oct. 17, when they'll host another struggling program, Penn State, with a first-year head coach (Matt Campbell) on a two-game losing streak.

articles.title: Croacia - España en directo: ¡segundo gol de Merino! | Última hora de UEFA Nations League en vivo hoy
articles.summary: Kovacic, sobre la derrota de Croacia: A ellos si les das tiempo con el balón son muy buenos y nosotros no podemos estar todo el rato agresivos ahí arr
articles.body:
Última hora del Croacia - España en directo

Muuuuuuuuuuy buenas tardeeeeeeeees. Croacia y España se vuelven a cruzar. Una semana después del 4-1 en Sevilla se ven las caras, ahora en Split. Es un duelo que se ha convertido en un clásico del siglo XXI. Será el decimotercer enfrentamiento de la historia, de los que diez se habrán producido a partir del año 2000. Eso hace que Croacia sea uno de los rivales ante el que más veces se ha enfrentado España desde el cambio de siglo. Una rivalidad que se ha repetido en Eurocopas (cuatro veces) y Nations League (cinco con el partido de Split) . En la Copa del Mundo no se ha dado. Pudo ser el de cuartos en 2018, pero España erró en octavos ante Rusia; y estuvo cerca de serlo en Estados Unidos en octavos, pero Portugal escapó por los pelos del levantamiento croata gracias a un anulado de esos que exigen una fe ciega en la tecnología.

El partido de Split aparece en un contexto inesperado. Croacia llega sacudida por la tremenda paliza sufrida en Rijeka a nte Inglaterra. Un equipo que siempre ha presumido de orgullo, de corazón, de ser capaz de plantar cara a quien sea bajo cualquier circunstancia fue aplastado de mala manera por los ingleses.

Al otro lado, la campeona del mundo. Una selección que es la imagen de la felicidad. Con sus dos estrellas en la camiseta, sus 41 partidos sin perder (42 si se extraen los amistosos desde la derrota en Glasgow en marzo de 2023) , su Lamine Yamal en modo mejor jugador del mundo, su seguridad de poder cambiar jugadores sin que nada se altere... Tan bien le van las cosa a España que a los dos partidos finales de noviembre -- en Praga y ante Inglaterra, en Madrid-- puede llegar clasificada para los cuartos de final. Si gana a Croacia, lo tiene; si empata también, porque los croatas sólo podrían llegar a 10 puntos y quedan por detrás en doble o triples empates.

Última parada de este megaparón, vamos a por ella. Arrrrrrrrrrancamooooooooos.

articles.title: Roy Revivo regresa con ganas al Elche: “Estoy muy emocionado”
articles.standfirst: El lateral israelí vuelve a estar disponible tras disputar cuatro encuentros con su selección y afronta con ilusión el duelo del domingo ante el Celta, un partido especial por el pasado de su padre, Haim Revivo, en el conjunto vigués
articles.summary: El lateral israelí vuelve a estar disponible tras disputar cuatro encuentros con su selección y afronta con ilusión el duelo del domingo ante el Celta, un partido especial por el pasado de su padre, Haim Revivo, en el conjunto vigués
articles.body: Roy Revivo ya está de vuelta. El futbolista del Elche ha regresado a la disciplina franjiverde después de tres semanas concentrado con la selección de Israel, con la que ha disputado cuatro encuentros de la Nations League. El lateral encara ahora con ilusión su regreso a la competición de clubes y espera volver a sentir el ambiente del Martínez Valero este domingo, a partir de las 14:00 horas, frente al Celta. “Estoy muy emocionado, especialmente cuando el partido es en casa. Estoy esperando a ver a los aficionados”, aseguró Revivo en la previa del encuentro. El israelí reconoce que la experiencia internacional ha sido exigente, aunque se muestra satisfecho por regresar a Elche. “Fueron partidos difíciles. Cuatro partidos en diez días no es fácil, pero me alegro de estar aquí ahora”, explicó el jugador, que vuelve con el objetivo de recuperar cuanto antes el ritmo competitivo con el conjunto ilicitano. Tras el parón internacional, Revivo considera fundamental que el equipo vuelva a encontrar sus mejores sensaciones y sea fiel a la idea de juego marcada por el entrenador. “Queremos ganar muchos partidos, encontrar nuestro juego y jugar como dice el míster”, señaló. El regreso del israelí llega, además, para un encuentro cargado de un componente emocional especial. El Celta fue uno de los equipos en los que militó su padre, Haim Revivo, una figura muy recordada en Vigo. Por ello, el duelo tendrá un significado añadido para toda la familia: “En todo caso para él será muy emocionante. Estará aquí con toda la familia”, reconoció Roy, que vivirá así un partido diferente ante el conjunto gallego. Revivo también quiso recordar el que fue uno de los momentos más especiales desde su llegada al Elche: su debut en el Martínez Valero. El lateral guarda en la memoria el ambiente vivido aquel día y espera repetir sensaciones este domingo: “Recuerdo mi debut aquí en el Martínez Valero, con todos los aficionados gritando. Fue una locura”, rememoró. Por ello, el internacional israelí tiene claro qué espera encontrar cuando salte al césped: “Espero que sea igual”. Un mensaje dirigido a una afición franjiverde que volverá a tener la oportunidad de recibir a uno de sus futbolistas después de su aventura con la selección.

articles.title: Martin O'Neill 'as determined as ever' to lead Celtic
articles.summary: Martin O'Neill insists he is the man to lead Celtic forwards after a period of reflection during the ongoing international break.
articles.body:
Martin O'Neill insists he is the man to lead Celtic forward after a "time of reflection" during the ongoing international break.

The 74-year-old signed a one-year deal to stay at Parkhead after two interim spells last season culminated in a league and Scottish Cup double.

Following two defeats by Rangers last month - either side of a 3-1 home defeat by Ferencvaros in the Europa League - O'Neill said "it might be time to wrap it up" , in reference to his managerial career.

However, Celtic rallied around their legendary boss, with chief executive Michael Nicholson publicly backing the Northern Irishman .

And two weeks on, O'Neill himself has now stated he has the drive to stay on.

"I am extremely prepared now for it," O'Neill said in a club interview. "We had a difficult week. That can happen. You can lose to your arch-rivals, you can lose the European game.

"It's certainly not the end of the world as it seemed to be described as. I thought I would take a bit of time, and it didn't take me that much time to think about it.

"I want to lead the club, I want to try to win the league and I'm just as determined now than ever before.

"It was a time of reflection for a moment or two, but overall, I'm back, I'm raring to go and the team's ready."

articles.title: Anirudh Thapa goal a brief bright spot as Uruguay run riot against India
articles.summary: In a disappointing finale to their home friendlies, India succumbed to a 6-1 loss against Uruguay, despite Anirudh Thapa's first-half goal showcasing brief promise. The match at Salt Lake Stadium highlighted India's defensive frailties, while Uruguay demonstrated their offensive prowess with a brace from Maxi Araujo and goals from Zalazar, Nunez, Sanabria, and Aguirre.
articles.body: TimesofIndia.com in Kolkata: India's third and final friendly test on home soil ended on a losing note as they went down 1-6 to Uruguay at the Salt Lake Stadium on Tuesday. Anirudh Thapa's first half strike gave the home faithful something to celebrate in what was a heartening performance in the first half despite the scoreline. A Brace from Maxi Araujo coupled with goals from Rodrigo Zalazar, Darwin Nunez, Juan Manuel Sanabria and Rodrigo Aguirre put the game beyond India.India held Panama to a 1-1 draw in Bengaluru in the first friendly of the FIFA international window. They were then swept aside 0-4 by Brazil on Saturday in Kolkata. The six goals conceded on Tuesday, in front of 37,307 fans, dampened what had been a promising start to the three important friendlies.In a game that witnessed a lightning strike enforced 30-minute delay, Uruguay were far and above the better side in the second half to nullify India's solid first half showcase.The promising start quickly unravelled as Uruguay capitalised on defensive lapses and moments of transition to secure a comprehensive win, their second of the tour of Asia, having earlier beaten South Korea.India, meanwhile, had their moments, particularly in the opening stages, but Uruguay’s greater quality in the final third eventually told. The visitors repeatedly exposed gaps behind the Indian defence, with Maxi Araujo and Zalazar among those making the most of the opportunities presented to them.India had the first meaningful opening in the fifth minute when Akash Mishra met a corner inside the box and attempted a left-footed strike, but his effort sailed over.Edmund Lalrindika was then presented with an even better opportunity after India won possession high up the pitch. The ball fell to him with only the goalkeeper to beat, but he lacked composure and drifted wide before running out of room.Uruguay were awarded a penalty soon after, with Pramveer adjudged to have brought down Federico Viñas inside the box. The decision was greeted with loud boos from the home crowd, who felt the Uruguay forward had gone down too easily. Darwin Nuñez made no mistake from the spot, sending Gurpreet Singh Sandhu the wrong way to give Uruguay the lead.The visitors almost doubled their advantage in the 16th minute. Nunez was sent through and, rather than shoot, cut the ball back for M. Araujo, whose curling effort beat Gurpreet but came back off the post.India responded impressively and were level in the 22nd minute.Ryan Williams found himself with plenty of space and, encouraged by the crowd, unleashed a shot that goalkeeper Thiago Cardozo could only spill. Anirudh Thapa reacted quickest, staying onside before producing a composed left-footed finish to make it 1-1.India continued to threaten, with Williams again involved minutes later. He drove forward on the right and found Edmund in the centre, but after a couple of touches inside the box, the Indian forward was crowded out by the Uruguay defence.The momentum was then interrupted by a thunderstorm. Play was stopped at 8:04pm, with players and staff sent back to the dressing rooms. After a 30-minute delay, as per FIFA's protocols revolving lightning, the match resumed.Uruguay needed just two minutes after the restart to regain the lead.A cross from the right by Nandez caught India off guard. Ashique Kuruniyan attempted to step up, but the space he left allowed Nandez to exploit the opening, with Araujo finishing the move to put Uruguay 2-1 ahead.India were increasingly vulnerable on the counter. Nunez was played through by Zalazar in the 37th minute and found himself completely clear, but his attempted chip was thwarted by Gurpreet, who stood tall and managed to get his body behind the effort.After the half time break, Uruguay took complete control of the game.Zalazar extended the lead in the 53rd minute after Nunez nodded the ball down into his path on the edge of the box. Zalazar took a touch before unleashing a powerful strike into the bottom corner, giving Gurpreet no chance.Araujo added his second of the night six minutes later. Viñas slipped a through ball behind the Indian defence and Araujo raced beyond the backline, shrugging off Abhishek Singh before calmly finishing past Gurpreet for 4-1.India continued to look for a response. Gurpreet denied Zalazar at one end, while Apuia tried his luck from distance at the other, only to see his effort sail over.Sanan briefly lifted the home crowd in the 69th minute, weaving past one defender before creating space for a long-range attempt. His lofted effort was punched over by the goalkeeper, prompting a huge roar from the stands.But Uruguay immediately exposed India at the other end.Another transition caught the hosts out and Sanabria finished at the far post to make it 5-1.The visitors added a sixth late on. Facundo Pellistri burst down the right before finding Aguirre in space on the edge of the box. Aguirre took a touch, wrong-footed Bijoy and curled a superb finish into the top corner, leaving substitute goalie Albino Gomes with no chance.Uruguay's 6-1 victory ultimately reflected the gulf between the sides in terms of ruthlessness and the ability to punish mistakes. articles.title: La botella de vino de Mourinho que cambió la forma de entender el éxito de Tiago Margarido
articles.standfirst: El entrenador recuerda la conversación que mantuvo con el técnico portugués en La Luz y que cambió su forma de entender qué significa realmente ser campeón
articles.summary: El entrenador recuerda la conversación que mantuvo con el técnico portugués en La Luz y que cambió su forma de entender qué significa realmente ser campeón
articles.body: Una botella de vino y una conversación con José Mourinho terminaron dejando en Tiago Margarido una de las lecciones que más han marcado su carrera. Así lo recuerda el entrenador en el último episodio de Homem do Leme tras mantener una imperdible conversación con Mourinho en La Luz y la respuesta que le dio cuando explicó que solo abriría el vino que le había regalado cuando conquistase un título. "El año pasado, cuando fuimos a jugar a La Luz, Jos tuvo un acto de grandeza conmigo, porque anteriormente había jugado contra nosotros en Madeira y yo le ofrecí una poncha (bebida portuguesa) de bienvenida, y en este caso para saludar su presencia allí en nuestro partido. En el partido de La Luz, él quiso corresponder y me ofreció una botella de vino bastante cara. Al final del partido, le dije al míster que solo abriría aquella botella cuando ganara un título, a lo que él me respondió que mi título en aquella época era conseguir la permanencia nacional y que tenía que abrirla si lo conseguía", explicó. La respuesta de Mourinho se quedó con él. Hasta el punto de convertirse en una de las grandes enseñanzas que, según reconoce, ha extraído de su carrera: "¿Cuál fue la lección que saqué de aquello? No siempre quien es campeón es realmente campeón, porque los entrenadores, cada uno de ellos, tienen sus objetivos y yo puedo ser un campeón consiguiendo una permanencia, consiguiendo una clasificación europea. Esa fue una gran lección que aprendí de José Mourinho".

articles.standfirst: El entrenador del Sporting sería uno de los nombres valorados por la Federación de Fútbol de Chile
articles.summary: El entrenador del Sporting sería uno de los nombres valorados por la Federación de Fútbol de Chile
articles.body: El Sporting de Gijón sigue avanzando paso a paso de la mano de Nicolás Larcamón. El conjunto rojiblanco, con más sombras que luces en cuanto a juego se refiere, sigue sumando puntos a su casillero y ya es uno de los clubes que forma parte del grupo perseguidor del 'playoff' de ascenso. Mientras trabaja en definir la identidad de su nuevo proyecto, el técnico del Sporting aparece en el radar de la Selección Chilena. La Federación de Fútbol de Chile se encuentra en busca de un nuevo seleccionador que tome las riendas de ‘La Roja’. Un puesto para el que se baraja un amplio abanico de nombres, entre los que aparece el de Nicolás Larcamón. Tal y como avanza ESPN Chile, el entrenador del Sporting es una de las opciones valoradas para asumir el cargo de seleccionador chileno. Junto a él, aparecen otros conocedores del fútbol español como Manuel Pellegrini, actualmente en el Betis, o Julen Lopetegui, exentrenador del Madrid o Sevilla, entre otros. Un viejo conocido del fútbol chileno. El entrenador argentino, recién llegado a la Segunda división española, cuenta con una dilatada trayectoria en el fútbol sudamericano. Precisamente, sus primeros pasos en los banquillos profesionales los dio en Chile, al frente de Deportes Antofagasta, Huachipato y Curicó Unido. Sus resultados positivos en la la liga chilena le sirvieron para dar el salto a clubes sudamericanos de la talla de Cruzeiro o Cruz Azul. Varios años después, la posibilidad de volver a Chile aparece en la vida de Larcamón. Pese a los rumores, el argentino no desvía su atención del banquillo del Sporting. “Venimos dentro de esa búsqueda de consistencia y mayor eficiencia, pero puntuando. Y eso es una gran noticia (…). Todo es tan parejo que mi responsabilidad es ser ecuánime y equilibrado”, expresaba un optimista Larcamón tras la victoria contra el Celta Fortuna. articles.title: Emmys move to Amazon Prime Video in historic six-year deal
articles.summary: The gala is leaving traditional US broadcast networks for live worldwide streaming.
articles.body:
Amazon Prime Video has secured exclusive global rights to stream the Emmy Awards under a six-year deal, ending the ceremony's run on traditional US broadcast television.

Starting in 2027, the agreement replaces a rotation of the gala among major networks like ABC, CBS, Fox and NBC. The ceremony will instead stream live for free worldwide each September, with no Prime Video subscription needed.

Official terms were not disclosed. The BBC has contacted Amazon and the Emmys for comment.

The move is another indication of how live events are shifting to digital platforms as viewing habits evolve. The Oscars, for example, are moving to YouTube live globally starting in 2029.

Mike Proulx, research director at Forrester, said the existing setup had become out of sync with modern television.

"The shows driving the industry forward largely originate on streaming platforms, yet the awards themselves were tethered to broadcast television," Proulx said.

"That's why a leading streaming service like Prime Video makes sense for the Emmy's next act."

Cris Abrego, chair of the Television Academy, said the deal gives the ceremony "unprecedented global reach", allowing audiences in more than 200 countries to watch live.

"Television has never been more global, and the Emmys should be a celebration that the world can share," Abrego said in a statement issued by Amazon.

Mike Hopkins, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, said the platform is honoured to serve as the "global home" for the ceremony, adding that streaming the show for free delivers " the best entertainment to our customers worldwide."

The agreement marks a milestone for Amazon, giving Prime Video its first marquee entertainment broadcast after building a live profile centred on sports, including the NFL's Thursday Night Football, NBA, and UEFA Champions League fixtures.

Amazon's latest earnings highlighted strong gains in live viewership , including record ratings for its inaugural NBA season, which peaked at 6.5 million viewers for Game 7 of the Eastern Conference Semifinals.

The Emmys deal positions Amazon directly alongside Google, whose video platform YouTube holds the upcoming Oscar rights.

YouTube relies primarily on an ad-supported model, whereas Amazon is leveraging free live access to draw massive global audiences into its wider ecosystem.

Like its live sporting events, the free broadcast will allow Amazon to build a substantial global advertising footprint.

Moving exclusively to Prime Video is significant for the Emmys, ending a rotation across the major legacy broadcast networks that has been in place since 1955 and marking the first time the gala will leave traditional broadcast television entirely.

First held in 1949, the Emmys honor achievements in acting, writing, and production, serving as a primary showcase for the global television industry.

articles.title: Michigan's Zack Marshall Apologizes for Leaked Text Messages Criticizing Team's Offense
articles.summary: Michigan tight end Zack Marshall apologized after letting his frustrations boil over following Saturday's loss to Minnesota.
articles.body:
Michigan tight end Zack Marshall apologized after letting his frustrations boil over following Saturday's loss to Minnesota.

Leaked text messages showed a player criticizing the Wolverines and declaring that tight ends aren't valued in their offense.

Marshall took to social media to own up to the situation, writing, "I let my frustrations speak for me in an emotional moment. I apologize to my teammates and coaches for the unnecessary drama that this has caused."

After recording 16 catches for 199 yards and a touchdown last season, Marshall has failed to record a catch five games into his senior campaign. Wolverines tight ends have combined for just nine catches for 65 yards in a passing offense that ranks last in the Big Ten with an average of 180.8 yards per game.

Marshall will try to focus on letting his play speak for him during the bye week before Michigan (3-2) returns to face Penn State (3-2) in a conference matchup on Oct. 17.

articles.title: Celtic boss Martin O'Neill confirms decision to stay after reflecting on future over international break
articles.summary: The Celtic boss admitted he would consider his future after three consecutive defeats, but 74-year-old Martin O'Neill has now declared himself up for the challenge; watch Motherwell vs Celtic on Sunday, live on Sky Sports, from 11am; kick-off 12pm
articles.body:
The Celtic manager admitted before the international break that he would consider his future after three consecutive defeats and talk to the board.

The 74-year-old has now declared himself up for the challenge after two defeats by Rangers sandwiched a Europa League setback against Ferencvaros.

When asked how ready and determined he was to lead the team forward, O'Neill told the club's Celtic Player : "I am. I'm extremely prepared for it.

"We had a difficult week. It can happen, you can lose to your arch-rivals, you can lose a European game.

"It's certainly not the end of the world, as it seemed to be described. But (I'm) ready to go.

"I did think I would take a little bit of time and it didn't take me that much time to think about it.

"I want to lead the club, I want to try and win the league, which is what we set out to do, and just as determined now as ever before.

"It was a time of reflection for a moment or two and, yes, some things that you think about.

"But overall, I'm back, I'm raring to go and the team's ready."

O'Neill, whose side face Motherwell at Fir Park on Sunday, live on Sky Sports , added: "What you try and do is analyse the things that you've done or perhaps the things that you haven't done.

"Throughout my managerial time, I've been exactly that. I think I look to myself, first of all. Maybe a wee bit different as a player, because I think I used to blame every other player for my own bad performance. But as a manager, you've got to look at yourself.

"And if you feel as if something has dropped away, of course you have to analyse it.

"Now, there wasn't a great deal in some of the games. If we get the equaliser just after half-time in the Rangers game, totally different ball game, totally different. But it wasn't to be. So you have to reflect on a few things like that.

"But overall, did the reflection, did all of that and a bit of self-analysing and just prepared for the battle."

O'Neill also revealed that Jota had played 45 minutes of a training-ground friendly against Falkirk on Friday, as the Portuguese winger steps up his comeback attempts following 18 months out with a knee injury.

The Celtic manager has also been encouraged by Alistair Johnston and Callum Osmand getting back on the training pitch following hamstring injuries.

O'Neill added he would assess the fitness of Hyun-Jun Yang on Friday after the South Korea winger experienced hamstring trouble on international duty.

Analysis: Celtic were always calm over O'Neill future

Martin O'Neill was never going to be sacked by Celtic after three humiliating defeats in one week before the international break - but there was a real potential of him walking away from the job.

After losing 1-0 at home to Rangers on September 20, O'Neill said he would take some time to think about whether he would continue as manager of the club.

Those comments sparked widespread reports and supporter speculation that the 74-year-old was on the verge of resigning.

Sky Sports News understands Celtic have always remained calm about the situation, despite the recent results. There was no appetite to pull the trigger themselves, especially when the teams are sitting at the top of the league.

That was proven when Celtic CEO Michael Nicholson backed O'Neill in a statement announcing the club's latest financial results. He said: "We will now come together and support Martin and the players, as we focus our efforts on achieving success domestically and in the Europa League."

The ball has been completely in O'Neill's court and - as he has said today - he very quickly indicated his intention and desire to stay.

Celtic face a tricky next five games back - Motherwell away (live on Sky Sports ), Benfica away, Hearts at home (live on Sky Sports ), Celta Vigo at home and Hibernian away (live on Sky Sports ).

It's going to be an interesting month ahead for O'Neill and Celtic.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Reportedly Gives 'Ultimatum' to Portugal National Team amid Jorge Jesus Rift
articles.summary: The rift between Portugal star striker Cristiano Ronaldo and head coach Jorge Jesus appears to have reached its breaking point.
articles.body:
The rift between Portugal star striker Cristiano Ronaldo and head coach Jorge Jesus appears to have reached its breaking point.

According to ESPN, Ronaldo has issued an ultimatum to Portugal, saying he will not return to the national team while Jesus is the coach.

Ronaldo released a lengthy statement explaining what created the conflict with Jesus, saying that despite initially agreeing that "it would be the right choice" to hire Jesus as Roberto Martínez's replacement following his resignation after the 2026 World Cup, the coach "had broken his word to me" multiple times, particularly when he left him on the bench for a Nations League match against Norway.

Things came to a head last week when Jesus said he wasn't going to be starting the 41-year-old in Thursday's match against Denmark, leading Ronaldo to announce that he had left Portugal's national team training camp.

"I decided to leave the camp without waiting for any further breach of word," Ronaldo said in his statement Tuesday. "For me the truth is still the most important thing in the relationship between people. However much it hurts, let them tell me the truth. ... I also owe an apology to my national team teammates for having left the camp. Despite the absolute breach of trust in the coach's word, as those who witnessed these conversations can attest, I should not have done it. The responsibility is exclusively mine."

Ronaldo acknowledged that he could face punishment for leaving the training camp, but he indicated that he would be willing to return to the team under the right circumstances.

"Therefore, if I am physically well, playing for my club, with goals I hope, after serving the suspension that may be applied to me, I will be available, as I have always been until today, to compete and win for our national team," Ronaldo stated. "This is, believe me, the purest of truths."

articles.title: Nebraska Selling Used Urinal Troughs from Memorial Stadium, Here's How Much Fans Are Paying
articles.summary: Nebraska is selling used urinal troughs from Memorial Stadium for $3,000 apiece as the Big Red Rebuild continues for the 103-year-old venue.
articles.body:
Nebraska is selling used urinal troughs from Memorial Stadium for $3,000 apiece as the Big Red Rebuild continues for the 103-year-old venue.

The cleaned troughs are 72 to 96 inches long and weigh 300 pounds.

Larry Holder of The Athletic reported that seven of the 30 urinals were bought as of Monday afternoon, according to Rare Goods co-founder Joe DiPietro (Rare Goods is helping Nebraska sell items from the stadium).

The Buffalo Bills have sold (and are still selling) items from their old Highmark Stadium, and they include urinal troughs. Per CollectibleXchange founder and CEO Brandon Steiner to Michael Petro of the Buffalo News , only a few of them remain as of Sunday. Per Holder, the Bills were trying to sell 40 troughs total for $5,000 each.

If you're wondering what fans can do with a trough, the BuyGR sales page offered some ideas.

"Fans at other stadiums have turned retired troughs into oversized planters, backyard conversation pieces, game-room displays, garden features, shop fixtures, and all kinds of projects that probably never appeared in the manufacturer's instruction manual."

Ultimately, if you're in the market for an original stadium trough, have $3,000 lying around and can pick it up yourself in Lincoln, then you're in luck.

And if you're a Nebraska fan, too, then that's a huge bonus as the Cornhuskers enjoy a great start to the season at 5-0 (2-0 Big Ten).

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo explica su marcha de Portugal: "Créanme, esta es la pura verdad"
articles.standfirst: El delantero luso apunta a Jorge Jesus y le acusa de mentir
articles.summary: El delantero luso apunta a Jorge Jesus y le acusa de mentir
articles.body: Cristiano Ronaldo ha dado sus explicaciones, como prometió tras su marcha de la concentración de Portugal. "Como prometí, decidí relatar, en primera persona y directamente, las circunstancias que rodearon la última etapa del viaje de la Selección Nacional. Después del Mundial de 2026, preparé una carta al pueblo portugués, que aún conservo, con las palabras que quiero dirigirles cuando deje definitivamente nuestro equipo. Al final de la competición, en el vuelo de regreso desde Estados Unidos, el Presidente de la Federación me pidió e insistió en que reconsiderara mi decisión de irme porque la FPF quería que continuara. Inmediatamente después, me pidió mi opinión sobre el nombre del actual Entrenador de la Selección Nacional, a quien estaba considerando, junto con otros nombres que no me reveló. Le respondí al Presidente de la Federación que, en mi opinión, sería la elección correcta. Por lo tanto, el día en que se presentó al actual Entrenador de la Selección Nacional, me sentí realmente feliz con la elección. Fue la opción correcta, como lo demuestran los resultados. Unos días después, recibí un primer contacto del nuevo entrenador de la selección nacional diciendo que le gustaría reunirse conmigo personalmente. Respondí que sí, y lo programamos para el final de mi vacaciones." Nos conocimos en la Ciudad del Fútbol, donde mi club estaba realizando su campamento de entrenamiento de pretemporada. Ese día, el entrenador me dijo que contaba conmigo y que mi presencia era fundamental para su proyecto. Me presentó un plan para mi participación en ese mismo momento. Me dijo que jugaría el primer y el último partido y que, por cuestiones de preparación física, siempre haría tres o cuatro cambios por partido. En ese momento, me sugirió que no viajara con la selección a Noruega y Dinamarca. Me propuso jugar el primer partido y quedarme en Portugal, para luego reincorporarme antes del partido en el estadio Dragão. Rechacé la propuesta de inmediato. Me pareció obvio que no podía aceptarla. No jugar los partidos en el extranjero no significaba que no sería capitán del equipo. Ese privilegio de quedarme en Portugal no sería un buen ejemplo. Finalmente, el entrenador estuvo de acuerdo con mi análisis. A esta conversación asistió Simão Coutinho, el director deportivo del Al Nassr, la persona a quien el actual seleccionador nacional reportó durante toda la temporada pasada y uno de los responsables de su fichaje por el club en 2025. En la víspera de la concentración, el seleccionador vino a mi casa en Lisboa para hablar conmigo de nuevo, a petición suya. La conversación fue tranquila y se mantuvieron todos los principios acordados en agosto. Jugué el partido en Alvalade, y aunque fui sustituido, no causé ningún problema. Personalmente le puse el brazalete de capitán a Bruno Fernandes, lejos de imaginar que podría estar dando mis últimos pasos como atleta y capitán de la selección nacional. Lo importante de ese día, para mí, fue nuestra victoria. Ganar siempre es bueno, en Portugal y para mi país, aún mejor. A la hora del almuerzo del día del partido en Noruega, un asistente del seleccionador nacional se acercó a la mesa donde el grupo estaba almorzando y me informó de que el seleccionador quería hablar conmigo. Para mi absoluta sorpresa, el entrenador me preguntó si estaba bien para jugar 30 minutos. Estaba completamente concentrado en mi recuperación física, integrado con mis compañeros como siempre, y pensando que no jugaría ese día. No había problema. Esta petición estaba fuera de mi plan de recuperación y entrenamiento físico, ya que solo iba a jugar el 4 en el estadio Dragão, pero obviamente dije que sí. Él respondió que debía estar preparado porque jugaría 30 minutos. El resto es historia. Calenté desde el descanso, vi pasar los minutos y no me llamaron. El entrenador había roto su palabra. Al final del partido, solo quería que todo terminara con una victoria y estar solo. No fui a saludar a los aficionados. Un error que es únicamente mi responsabilidad y que no debería haber ocurrido. Pido disculpas al pueblo portugués que nos apoyó intensamente allí, pido disculpas a los aficionados y pido disculpas a quienes, sin ser portugueses, viajaron hasta allí para verme y a quienes pude haber decepcionado. Cuarenta y ocho horas después, tuvimos una conversación: yo, el entrenador y Simão Coutinho, ya que había estado siguiendo nuestras conversaciones en agosto. Fue un momento profundo y muy franco, sin filtros. Acordamos que solo había una manera de cerrar este "caso": que el entrenador repetiría lo que me acababa de decir en privado, en presencia de Simão Coutinho, pero en la sala de prensa. El acuerdo era simple: el entrenador comenzaría la rueda de prensa con este tema, intentando zanjar el asunto diciendo la verdad. Diría que yo nunca pedí jugar ningún minuto, que fue el entrenador, y nadie más, quien propuso el plan para esta concentración, y que fue un error hacerme calentar solo para no jugar, y que si volvía a suceder, no lo haría. Terminamos esa reunión con el entrenador pidiéndome un abrazo, prometiéndome que diría en la rueda de prensa lo que me acababa de decir, y que el asunto estaba resuelto. No jugaría en Dinamarca, pero sí en el partido contra el Dragão. Todo esto tuvo lugar en presencia de Simão Coutinho, como siempre. A petición del entrenador, se celebró una videoconferencia entre él, Simão Coutinho y Tiago Craveiro, en la que se resumió lo que habíamos hablado. Se elaboró un breve documento, que yo mismo revisé y que, con mi conocimiento, se le entregó al entrenador, tal como él había solicitado. La conferencia transcurrió como se esperaba: su actitud no tenía nada que ver con nuestra reunión; percibí expresiones y agresividad que considero inmerecidas, una actitud de "yo quiero, yo puedo y yo mando" que jamás me había mostrado, ni siquiera remotamente, en privado, el día anterior. Las notas que validé fueron las siguientes: 'Creo que es importante, porque es la verdad, aclarar algunas cosas antes de hablar de Dinamarca: 1. Yo personalmente propuse un plan para Cristiano, sin nadie más, para él en esta temporada deportiva con la Selección Nacional. Fue una conversación larga y muy buena. 2. Sé cuánto vive y ama a la Selección Nacional y el peso que tiene en el mundo, aún más, el peso y la influencia positiva que ha tenido en la Selección Nacional durante 24 años consecutivos. 3. El plan que le propuse a Cristiano fue aceptado. 4. Nunca cuestionó mis decisiones. Fue ejemplar, leal y profesional. 5. El partido de Noruega no estaba incluido en el plan que le tracé. Sin embargo, sentí que había logrado recuperarse físicamente del primer partido y le advertí que podría tener que usarlo. Cristiano estuvo de acuerdo. 6. Cometí un error al poner a alguien de la talla de Pelé o Maradona a calentar solo para no ponerlo en el partido. Si fuera hoy, no lo haría. 7. Para concluir: Quiero a Cristiano en la Selección Nacional. "En realidad, no quiero poco, quiero mucho. Por suerte, él también cree en mí. Creía en Al Nassr y aquí también. 8. Respecto a no saludar a la afición. Ya hemos hablado de eso. Alguien que juega más de 230 partidos con la Selección Nacional no recibe lecciones de amor por Portugal de mi parte. Fue un momento de frustración que no borra nada. Es el jugador que más autógrafos da, más selfies se toma y más cariño muestra a la afición. No inventemos problemas donde no los hay. Cuando no estamos contentos, reaccionamos. Eso es todo." Ninguna de esas notas, por lo tanto, decía que el entrenador se hubiera disculpado conmigo. Era la segunda vez que rompía mi palabra. Decidí abandonar el campo de entrenamiento sin esperar otra promesa incumplida. Para mí, la verdad sigue siendo lo más importante en las relaciones interpersonales. Por mucho que duela, quiero que me digan la verdad. De hecho, en una conversación que tuve con el presidente de la Federación Portuguesa de Fútbol y el entrenador la mañana de esa rueda de prensa, que seguramente pueden confirmar, reafirmé que si no me querían allí, simplemente debían decírmelo. Solo necesitaban ser sinceros conmigo. Yo lo aceptaría y prometí que prepararíamos algo hermoso, como sueño que sucederá, y nadie se enfadaría. Lo recuerdo como si fuera ayer. Respondieron al unísono que no. Que mi lugar estaba en la Selección Nacional. Nunca, en ningún momento, he interferido en ninguna decisión técnica o táctica de ningún entrenador o seleccionador nacional en casi 25 años de mi carrera. Acepto, para bien o para mal, lo que proponen hacer. Respeto la decisión, y cuando rompen mi palabra, siento que mi lugar no está ahí. También les debo una disculpa a mis compañeros de la selección nacional por abandonar la concentración. A pesar de la absoluta falta de confianza en la palabra del entrenador, como cualquiera que haya presenciado estas conversaciones puede atestiguar, no debí haberlo hecho. La responsabilidad es exclusivamente mía. Me disculpo una vez más con el pueblo portugués, pero romper mi palabra tiene un impacto determinante en mí. Sentí que, a partir de ese momento, mi permanencia solo perjudicaría al equipo, e hice lo que siempre dije que haría si no me sentía útil: hice las maletas y me fui. Las consecuencias de mis actos deben ser evaluadas y sancionadas por la Federación Portuguesa de Fútbol. Creo que el castigo no debe atenuarse. No soy un jugador cualquiera; soy el capitán del equipo, y eso es un factor agravante. Ya me he disculpado, pero sé que los actos deben tener consecuencias. Cualquiera en el fútbol, como yo, sabe que, independientemente de la posición individual, las reglas son las mismas para todos. En este sentido, he oído mucho sobre partidos de despedida, que necesito una despedida digna, y que la Federación quiere darme esa oportunidad. Aprendí en la vida, a menudo con hambre y sin nada que comer, que nadie le da nada a nadie gratis. Puedo prometer a todos mis seguidores, naturalmente y especialmente a todo el pueblo portugués, que jugaremos uno o más partidos de despedida; habrá tiempo para eso. Pero cuando pienso en la selección nacional, en lo que realmente pienso es en competir. Eso es lo que pensé el día que recibí la noticia de la muerte de mi padre. Estaba en el campo de entrenamiento con nuestra selección nacional y decidí quedarme allí hasta que terminara el partido del día siguiente. Hice por el país lo que nunca haría por ningún club. Por lo tanto, si estoy en buena forma física, jugando para mi club y, con suerte, marcando goles, después de cumplir mi sanción, estaré disponible, como siempre lo he estado, para competir y ganar con nuestra Selección Nacional. Créanme, esta es la pura verdad. Cristiano Ronaldo, 6 de octubre de 2026

articles.title: Uno a uno de España ante Croacia: Unai Simón, el portero más infravalorado del mundo
articles.standfirst: Analizamos la actuación de los jugadores y de Luis de la Fuente
articles.summary: Analizamos la actuación de los jugadores y de Luis de la Fuente
articles.body: Unai Simón lleva conviviendo con el ruido desde que se hizo con la portería de España. Pero a él, un hombre sereno y tranquilo como pocos, todo eso le importa un bledo. El debate sobre quién debe jugar, las dudas, las tertulias de barra de bar... ruido. Nada más. Luis de la Fuente le entregó la portería en la Eurocopa y respondió. Se la volvió a entregar en el Mundial y respondió. Ahora quiere la Nations League. Contra Croacia volvió a hacerlo. Tuvo más trabajo que en buena parte del Mundial: cuatro paradas que explican una actuación, aunque no toda. Porque lo más importante no fueron las intervenciones, sino la sensación que transmitió durante los 90 minutos. La de que, si Croacia encontraba un resquicio, él iba a estar ahí y que lo iba a parar. El portero más infravalorado del mundo callando bocas. Otra vez. Primera parte: Paradón de Unai para salvar el 1-0. Voló Stanisic... pero el portero español tiró de reflejos para cerrar la portería. Paradón al disparo de Matanovic, pero Perisic caza el rechace y marca a placer. Otra más de Unai, que sale muy bien para detener la progresión croata. Está teniendo más trabajo hoy que en todo el Mundial. Tremendo. NOTA DESCANSO: 7 Segunda parte: Salva Unai el tanto de Perisic tras un error garrafal de Zubimendi en la salida de balón. Tremendo el pie que saca para salvar el 2-1... porque le había cogido a contrapié. NOTA FINAL: 9 Primera parte: Tapa a las mil maravillas el disparo de Perisic. Se duerme Pubill en la segunda acción que le acaba costando el tanto a Croacia. Dura entrada de Perisic ahora... y amarilla para el croata. NOTA DESCANSO: 7 Segunda parte: Lo mismo que el resto de defensas. Una segunda parte más tranquila y con la sensación de que este partido se les podía marchar sólo con errores. NOTA FINAL: 7 Primera parte: Tratando de pausar la salida de balón de España, pero el ritmo en este inicio de partido está siendo frenético. Blandito el despeje de Cubarsí, pero luego reacciona rápido para blocar el disparo, que se marcha a córner. NOTA DESCANSO: 5 Segunda parte: Gran balón de Cubarsí para dejar a Lamine solito frente a Lavikovic. Salva el segundo de Croacia con un gran salto aéreo. Tremendo. NOTA FINAL: 7 Primera parte: Casi regala España el 2-0. El central perdió un balón ante la presión de Vlasic... y obliga a Unai a salvar otra vez a España al disparo a bocajarro de Matanovic. Bien Laporte ahora, contundente para cortar la contra. NOTA DESCANSO: 5 Segunda parte: Mucho más tranquilo en la segunda parte, con menos trabajo y simplemente con la mirada puesta en evitar las contras del rival. NOTA FINAL: 7 Primera parte: Versión más irreconocible de Cucurella con España. Más superado que de costumbre. Buenísimo el balón del lateral al corazón del área, encuentra a Olmo... pero el remate se marcha fuera. NOTA DESCANSO: 6 Segunda parte: Se queda solo frente a Livakovic... pero estaba en fuera de juego. No valía la acción. 'Provoca' la expulsión de Perisic, que ve la segunda amarilla tras cazar por detrás al lateral español. Le pitan desde la grada cada vez que toca el balón. ¿Qué culpa tendrá Cucurella? Me pregunto. NOTA FINAL: 7 Primera parte: Tratando de achicar agua ante la presión y velocidad croata. Se duerme en banda y le roban el balón para montar la contra. NOTA DESCANSO: 6 Segunda parte: Estuvo rápido el centrocampista, ganándole la carrera y rebañándole la posesión a Kovacic. Amarilla para Rodri por un agarrón sobre Jakic. Se marcha en el 70' para dar entrada a Zubimendi. NOTA FINAL: 6 Primera parte: Le está costando un mundo entrar en juego. Se asocia bien con Oyarzabal pero le cortan el paso en el área. Poco a poco se adueña del tiempo del partido. Qué auténtica maravilla de Pedri, por favor. Control de mago y balón de genio para el desmarque de Lamine, que perdona el empate. NOTA DESCANSO: 6 Segunda parte: Vaya cambio le ha pegado a España en la segunda parte. Hace girar a todo el equipo para jugar a su antojo. NOTA FINAL: 7 Primera parte: Se mueve mucho por dentro, pero no le consiguen encontrar en medio de la telaraña croata. Mucha gente por dentro y así es complicado. Tira buen desmarque tras leer el pase de Lamine, pero no llega por muy poquito. Muy necesarias esta acciones para hacerles dudar y generar más espacios. NOTA DESCANSO: 5 Segunda parte: Tiene Olmo la primera de España en la segunda parte... pero su disparo se marcha alto. Otra que no llega por milímetros. Perdona España el 1-0. Se marcha al banquillo en el minuto 70 para dar entrada a Fermín. NOTA FINAL: 5 Primera parte: Primera de Lamine. Arranca en banda, se marcha de uno, pase atrás... y de milagro no encuentra a un compañero. Tapó bien Modric. Balón alto que volvía a filtrar Lamine Yamal a la espalda de la zaga croata. Lo va a pasar mal Gvardiol con Lamine. Cada vez que agarra el balón tiene 3 futbolistas encima. Arrastra mucho... pero no encuentra a nadie sin marca para hacer daño. Robo inteligente de Lamine, pisa área... pero nadie caza su pase de la muerte. NOTA DESCANSO: 6 Segunda parte: La que ha tenido Lamine!! Balón largo a Cubarsí que deja solo a su compañero, se planta solo delante de Livakovic, se intente ir de él... pero el portero croata aguanta bien y no cae en la trampa. Tremendo balón al segundo palo que no caza Olmo por muy poco. Sigue arrastrando muuuuucho... pero no termina generando tanto peligro como nos tiene acostumbrados. De la Fuente se salta su propia regla... y no sienta a Lamine a pesar de llevar ya más de 270 minutos entre los cuatro partidos de la Nations League. Se marcha en el 77 para dar entrada a Víctor. No le ha gustado nada el cambio al extremo... por lo que se ha visto por TV. NOTA FINAL: 6 Primera parte: Se mete en exceso por dentro... y así es complicado porque se acumulan muchos jugadores en un espacio muy reducido. NOTA DESCANSO: 5 Segunda parte: Se queda en el vestuario tras el descanso para dar entrada a Merino. NOTA FINAL: 5 Primera parte: Susto nada más empezar tras recibir un duro golpe. Cojeaba, pero ya parece recuperado, sin problemas. Balón en largo, la controla en el área... pero su remate, forzoso, se marcha fuera. NOTA DESCANSO: 5 Segunda parte: Desaparecido en la segunda parte. Intento hacerse un hueco en el área... pero no ha podido cazar ni uno. Su trabajo consistió en fijar centrales para dar espacio a sus compañeros. NOTA FINAL: 5 Segunda parte: Entra tras el descanso por Baena. Don Mikel Merino. Aparece siempre... porque siempre está donde tiene que estar. Tremendo. Otra que caza, otra que manda a la cazuela. Con él los xG no tienen sentido. El don de la ubicuidad: saber estar en el momento exacto, en el sitio adecuado y sin hacer mucho ruido. Por faaaaaavor, que auténtica maravilla. Qué puñetero futbolista (acabo de escuchar en la redacción). El segundo del 6 de España. Que se saca un control orientado de la nada, se gira y la escuadra. Mamma mía, qué puñetero futbolista. Don Mikel Merino. NOTA FINAL: Matrícula de Honor... porque no se puede dar más. Primera parte: Caraja importante de sus hombres en el arranque del partido por el ritmo alto de Croacia... que saltó al césped con el colmillo entre los dientes. Con el paso de los minutos, España se fue haciendo con el balón y mereció más (al menos en el marcador). Dudas en defensa con Unai teniendo que aparecer en demasiadas ocasiones para salvar a los suyos. NOTA DESCANSO: 5 Segunda parte: Gran segunda parte de España, que domin´po a Croacia, generó muchas ocasiones... y dejó de sufrir atrás. A este nivel no veo selección en el Mundo que pueda ganar a España. Qué bonito ser español. NOTA FINAL: 8 Segunda parte: Entra en el 71 por Rodri. Error garrafal en la salida de balón que casi le cuesta el 2-1 a España. Le salva Unai. Fuera de juego del centrocampista cuando España buscaba el gol de la victoria.
